searchBoundary: Primary papers, official repositories, and official institutional copies were searched for early battery-life prediction, impedance and pulse features, held-condition validation, protocol leakage, repeated-check-up degradation modes, multimodal limits, and public HG2 data. Similarity does not establish novelty.

evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.evidence: The cited studies establish their reported cohorts, measurements, validation splits, and limitations.
evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.inference: RC52 and RC53 failures suggest that static early features may confound protocol with cell susceptibility; this is a cross-cycle interpretation, not a result reported by the cited authors.
evidenceInferenceProposalBoundary.proposal: The CU0-to-CU1 logarithmic EIS/pulse response fingerprint and complete 40-degree holdout are preregistered tests. They are not described as novel or effective before adjudication.

sources.title: Comprehensive battery aging dataset: capacity and impedance fade measurements of a lithium-ion NMC/C-SiO cell
sources.usedFor: Primary cohort design: 228 same-batch HG2 cells, 76 triplicate conditions, four temperatures, three aging families, and repeated standardized capacity/EIS/pulse check-ups.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The data descriptor does not adjudicate the preregistered nested Weibull models or a complete held-40-degree EOL bridge.

sources.title: Comprehensive battery aging dataset: capacity and impedance fade measurements of a lithium-ion NMC/C-SiO cell — result data version 2
sources.usedFor: Official configuration, processed EOC/EIS/pulse results, hashes, identifiers, and nearly 600-day continuation.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Repository availability does not validate a model; target outcomes remain sealed until the preregistration commit.

sources.title: Data-driven prediction of battery cycle life before capacity degradation
sources.usedFor: Primary precedent that early discharge-curve changes can predict LFP cycle life and that validation must separate training, primary test, and secondary test cells.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A 124-cell fast-charge LFP result does not prove transport to NMC/C-SiO calendar, cyclic, and WLTP aging or to an unseen temperature.

sources.title: Predicting the impact of formation protocols on battery lifetime immediately after manufacturing
sources.usedFor: Primary evidence that low-SOC resistance after formation can correlate strongly with cycle life and may expose an early cell-level signal.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A static formation resistance correlation is not a CU0-to-CU1 response-rate test and does not resolve held-temperature survival calibration.

sources.title: Impedance-based forecasting of lithium-ion battery performance amid uneven usage
sources.usedFor: Primary evidence that EIS and early voltage-curve information can be complementary under uneven usage, while equivalent-circuit compression can discard predictive structure.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its datasets and holdouts do not test the five-SOC CU0/CU1 response fingerprint on all 57 held 40-degree HG2 cells.

sources.title: Data leakage in battery lifetime prediction
sources.usedFor: Primary warning that cycling-condition features can make nominally strong lifetime predictions without resolving cell-to-cell variability, motivating complete condition holdouts and within-condition ranking.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The leakage diagnosis does not identify which early electrochemical response, if any, carries transportable susceptibility information.

sources.title: Predicting battery lifetime under varying usage conditions from early aging data
sources.usedFor: Primary precedent for hierarchical condition/cell modeling and early reference-performance-test degradation modes across 225 NMC/graphite cells.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its reported in-distribution and out-of-distribution errors do not adjudicate an unseen-temperature HG2 EOL test with broadband EIS and pulse responses.

sources.title: Identifying degradation patterns of lithium ion batteries from impedance spectroscopy using machine learning
sources.usedFor: Primary small-cohort evidence that low-frequency EIS can track capacity and forecast an 80% endpoint without a full equivalent-circuit reduction.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Twelve LCO coin cells cycled under limited protocols cannot establish temperature and aging-family transport in the HG2 cohort.

sources.title: Discovery learning for battery lifetime prediction
sources.usedFor: Primary evidence that public-dataset pretraining plus a limited prototype subset can reduce experimental demand for industrial pouch-cell lifetime prediction.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Transfer learning accuracy does not reveal whether a one-week impedance response adds a causal or within-condition bridge in this same-batch public cohort.

sources.title: Limits of electrochemical data for predicting battery lifetime and failure
sources.usedFor: Current boundary analysis: electrochemical measurements can miss electrolyte depletion, internal shorts, and latent mechanical defects, so predictive success must not be equated with universal failure observability.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A perspective defines a modality boundary but does not determine the RC54 verdict.

noveltyStatement: RC54 makes no algorithmic novelty claim. The potentially distinctive object is a falsifiable combination: four zero-weight schema pilots, a complete held-temperature cohort, right-censored 80% EOL, nested static-versus-response diagnostics at five SOCs, within-triplicate concordance, calibration gates, and independent recomputation. The search found each component's motivation but did not establish publication of this exact adjudication.
